from tensorflow.keras.models import Model

class DL_Model(Model):
    def __init__(self):
        super(DL_Model, self).__init__()
        # Branch 1: 3x3 convolutions
        self.branch1_conv = Conv2D(filters=64, kernel_size=(3, 3), strides=(1, 1), padding='same', activation='relu')

        # Branch 2: 1x1 convolutions followed by two 3x3 convolutions
        self.branch2_conv1 = Conv2D(filters=64, kernel_size=(1, 1), strides=(1, 1), padding='same', activation='relu')
        self.branch2_conv2 = Conv2D(filters=64, kernel_size=(3, 3), strides=(1, 1), padding='same', activation='relu')
        self.branch2_conv3 = Conv2D(filters=64, kernel_size=(3, 3), strides=(1, 1), padding='same', activation='relu')

        # Branch 3: Max pooling
        self.branch3_pool = MaxPool2D(pool_size=(3, 3), strides=(1, 1), padding='same')
        self.branch3_conv = Conv2D(filters=64, kernel_size=(1, 1), strides=(1, 1), padding='same', activation='relu')

        # Concatenation and classification layers
        self.concatenate = Concatenate(axis=-1)
        self.flatten = Flatten()
        self.dense1 = Dense(units=512, activation='relu')
        self.dense2 = Dense(units=10, activation='softmax')

    def call(self, inputs):
        # Branch 1
        branch1 = self.branch1_conv(inputs)

        # Branch 2
        branch2 = self.branch2_conv1(inputs)
        branch2 = self.branch2_conv2(branch2)
        branch2 = self.branch2_conv3(branch2)

        # Branch 3
        branch3 = self.branch3_pool(inputs)
        branch3 = self.branch3_conv(branch3)

        # Concatenate branches
        concatenated = self.concatenate([branch1, branch2, branch3])

        # Classification
        flattened = self.flatten(concatenated)
        dense1 = self.dense1(flattened)
        output = self.dense2(dense1)

        return output

from tensorflow.keras.models import Model

        self.branch2_conv1 = Conv2D(filters=64, kernel_size=(1, 1), strides=(1, 1), padding='same', activation='relu')
        self.branch2_conv2 = Conv2D(filters=64, kernel_size=(3, 3), strides=(1, 1), padding='same', activation='relu')
        self.branch2_conv3 = Conv2D(filters=64, kernel_size=(3, 3), strides=(1, 1), padding='same', activation='relu')

        # Branch 3: Max pooling
        self.branch3_pool = MaxPool2D(pool_size=(3, 3), strides=(1, 1), padding='same')
        self.branch3_conv = Conv2D(filters=64, kernel_size=(1, 1), strides=(1, 1), padding='same', activation='relu')

        # Concatenation and classification layers
        self.concatenate = Concatenate(axis=-1)
        self.flatten = Flatten()
        self.dense1 = Dense(units=512, activation='relu')
        self.dense2 = Dense(units=10, activation='softmax')

    def call(self, inputs):
        # Branch 1
        branch1 = self.branch1_conv(inputs)

        # Branch 2
        branch2 = self.branch2_conv1(inputs)
        branch2 = self.branch2_conv2(branch2)
        branch2 = self.branch2_conv3(branch2)

        # Branch 3
        branch3 = self.branch3_pool(inputs)
        branch3 = self.branch3_conv(branch3)

        # Concatenate branches
        concatenated = self.concatenate([branch1, branch2, branch3])

        # Classification
        flattened = self.flatten(concatenated)

        return output
